scene: A crowded covered fish market in the harbour town at mid-morning, wet stone floor, hanging lanterns

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair, pale freckled skin and a dark green hooded wool cloak, hood up
subjects.position: centre, moving through the crowd toward the camera
subjects.action: glancing sideways at a stall while keeping her head low
subjects.pose: walking, shoulders hunched, three-quarter front view

subjects.description: Fishmongers in rubber aprons and a dozen townsfolk with baskets
subjects.position: filling the frame around her, slightly out of focus

style: painterly cinematic concept art, visible brush texture, storyboard key frame
lighting: diffuse skylight from a glass roof, warm lantern accents, wet reflections on the floor
background: stalls of silver fish on ice, hanging nets, a painted sign reading "HARBOUR MARKET"
composition: medium shot through the crowd, foreground figures framing her, strong depth

camera.depth_of_field: shallow, crowd soft, her face sharp
